title: Passing Yards Speed Step 7 Same-Session Full Analysis Transition
objective: Measure and remove the remaining user-visible delay caused by the lazy-shell Load Full Analysis transition, without changing any frozen football/model/data/projection/context/probability/market/sportsbook behavior.
current_first_broken_arrow: Lazy shell -> Load Full Analysis -> selected-QB full detail ready
diagnostic_action: One branch browser profile proving whether the current V79 Load Full Analysis anchor causes a full document navigation and measuring click-to-ready versus frozen V77 server-render telemetry.

current_failure_epoch.root_cause: The public Streamlit widget rerun transport adds 7.781s outside the frozen V82 wrapper even after V84 removes the explicit second rerun. The remaining bottleneck is the widget/server rerun transport itself, not football computation.
current_failure_epoch.patch: V85 replaces the Streamlit widget activation path with st.html same-tab direct navigation to the existing ks_py_full=1 URL. This bypasses the public widget rerun transport while preserving all query context and the frozen V84 -> V83 -> V82 full-analysis chain.

root_cause.conclusion: Legacy V79 Load Full Analysis anchor is sanitized/rendered with target=_blank. The current Streamlit document remains on the lazy URL, so ks_py_full=1 never activates in the existing session.

product_patch.description: Render a same-tab direct-full control with st.html and window.location.assign to the certified ks_py_full=1 URL. No Streamlit button or st.rerun transport on the lazy-to-full transition.

navigation_change_scope: Transport only: same-tab direct navigation to the existing full-analysis URL. Date, matchup, QB slot, hints, model/data/projection/probability/market/sportsbook behavior remain unchanged.
